headline: Saima Wazed resigns from WHO amid fraud probes
summary: The Regional Director for South-East Asia resigns following allegations of financial irregularities and false educational credentials.
details: Saima Wazed, the World Health Organization's (WHO) Regional Director for South-East Asia, has officially resigned from her post. She submitted her resignation letter to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus on Wednesday.

The resignation follows investigations into allegations of financial irregularities during trips to China, providing false information regarding her educational qualifications, and the illegal acquisition of plots in Bangladesh.

Wazed, who assumed office in February 2024 for a five-year term, was placed on unpaid leave in July 2025 following corruption probes by the Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) in Bangladesh after the fall of the Awami League government.

Through her lawyers, Wazed has denied all allegations. She claimed a $901 discrepancy in her China trip expenses was an administrative error by an assistant and stated that the WHO chief had been informed that her doctorate was honorary.
In her resignation letter, Wazed expressed a loss of confidence in WHO leadership, stating that they had hindered her ability to perform her duties effectively.
She also cited an 'unbearable' financial situation resulting from nearly a year of unpaid leave.

WHO sources indicate that a formal process to remove her from the post was already underway. A new nomination for the position may be announced by October 12, and elections for a new Regional Director are expected by January 24.

headline_marked: Starting at $1,999, [[Apple unveils iPhone Duo]], its first foldable smartphone
headline: Starting at $1,999, Apple unveils iPhone Duo, its first foldable smartphone
summary: The new book-style device features a 7.6-inch inner display, a titanium frame, and the powerful A20 Pro chip.
details: Apple has officially launched the iPhone Duo, its first-ever foldable smartphone. The device features a book-style design with a 7.6-inch inner display and a 5.4-inch outer screen.

Built from grade 5 titanium, the phone is the thinnest iPhone Apple has ever made when opened. It includes a complex hinge made of over 100 components and an IP68 rating for water and dust resistance.
The device is powered by the A20 Pro 2-nanometre processor, delivering up to 35% better sustained performance than the iPhone 17 Pro. It is supported by a custom vapour-chamber cooling system.
iOS 27 introduces new multitasking capabilities for the Duo, including Split View for running two apps side-by-side and the ability to interact with Siri AI while keeping other apps visible.
The camera system boasts a 48-megapixel Fusion Main camera and a 48-megapixel ultra-wide lens. A new 'Duo Preview' feature allows subjects to see the live framing on the outer screen during shoots.
Battery life is managed by a dual-battery design, offering up to 31 hours of video playback on the inner screen and 44 hours on the outer. Wired charging can reach 50% in approximately 20 minutes.
The iPhone Duo comes in 'star white' and 'night sky' with storage options up to 2TB. It is an eSIM-only device worldwide, supporting Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6.
Pre-orders for the iPhone Duo begin on 16 October, with official availability starting 23 October in over 70 countries and regions. Prices start at $1,999 in the US.
